build_activation: build a PyTorch activation layer from an Activation enum like ReLU, GeLU, or SmeLU
get_linear: build a linear layer with optional activation and dropout using get_linear
get_feedforward: build a feedforward network with expand and project layers using get_feedforward
no_weight_decay: get a set of parameter names to exclude from weight decay in a PyTorch model
init_linear_weights: initialize all linear layer weights in a model using Xavier uniform initialization
